All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Security update for helm", "title": "Title of the patch"}, {"category": "description", "text": "This update for helm fixes the following issues

Update to version 3.21.3.

- CVE-2026-39821: golang.org/x/net/idna: failure to reject ASCII-only Punycode-encoded labels allows for validation
  bypass and privilege escalation (bsc#1266598).
- CVE-2026-48978: oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote/auth: missing validation in `auth.Client()` allows a malicious
  registry to hijack Bearer token realms to exfiltrate credentials and refresh tokens (bsc#1270127).
- CVE-2026-56852: golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm: handling of input containing truncated/invalid UTF-8 input can
  lead to infinite loop (bsc#1271997).

Changes for helm:

- Update `x/text` to 0.40.0.
- Update `x/net` to 0.57.0.
- Update to version 3.21.3:
  * Apply suggestions from code review 1ad6e68 (Benoit Tigeot).
  * fix: drop `containerd` v1 dep to resolve govulncheck CVEs 037733e (Benoit Tigeot).
  * chore(deps): bump `github.com/containerd/containerd` from 1.7.32 to 1.7.33 d3e178b (dependabot[bot]).
